title: Chapter 290 Three Years Have Passed
content:
Chapter 290 Three Years Have Passed

Later, Lu Xue and others learned that the entire ancient battlefield was actually controlled by the four ancient tribes.

If you want to enter the ancient battlefield, you must be recognized by the four clans.

This agreement was settled a long time ago.

Even though the Xiao clan gradually declined later, the other three clans still could not interfere with the power on the ancient battlefield.

However, although the three tribes did not intervene, there were very few Xiao tribes who entered the ancient battlefield.

"By the way, I forgot to tell you that because of the current turmoil in the fairy world, some changes have occurred in the ancient battlefield."

At this time, Xiao Jing reminded.

"Change? Great Elder, what's the matter?"

Xiao Luo asked.

In response, Xiao Jing continued: "There may be other gaps in the ancient battlefield, so there are not only people recognized by the four major families."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and others immediately understood.

In other words, after entering the ancient battlefield, you must not only beware of the dangers inside, but also beware of other people's peeking at you.

If it were ever, the entire ancient battlefield was basically filled with people from the four ancient tribes, and everyone would still help each other.

Even if there is anything wrong with each other, they will not fight each other.

This style lasted for a long time and only changed recently.

The Xiao clan was almost destroyed by people from the other three clans. Even if the Xiao clan has a good temper, he naturally can't bear it.

But when Chu Lingsheng heard this, he regretted it.

Is there any passage outside to enter the ancient battlefield? ?

Then what kind of transactions do you have with Lu Xue? Just go find them by yourself.

It's a loss, it's a loss.

At this time, Xiao Luo looked low.

As if he saw Xiao Luo’s thoughts, Xiao Jing said, “Xiao Luo, you can do whatever you want when you enter. As long as you can come out alive, we will take care of you when you come out.”

Hearing this, Xiao Luo was moved.

"Great Elder, I get it."

"arrive."

As soon as he finished speaking, a heavy aura came to his face.

I saw a wasteland appearing in front of me, gloomy and extremely desolate.

A broken stone tablet stood in front of the wasteland, and it exuded an indescribable aura.

Even after years of erosion, everyone can still see that this stone tablet has had a glorious history.

It’s a pity that it has been completely blown up now.

Seeing the scene in front of him, Lu Xue and others looked solemn.

It seems that this ancient battlefield is really dangerous.

At this time, Lu Xue looked around and frowned slightly.

Nothing felt.

But it is naturally impossible to say that there is no one here to guard it.

Moreover, the elders of the Xiao clan came in person, but no one appeared.

So there is only one possibility. The people guarding here are at a higher level than the elder of the Xiao clan.

It seems that these four ancient tribes are far more than just looking like this.

"Sister Xue, let's go in."

Xiao Luo looked at Lu Xuedao.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue no longer hesitated and nodded slightly, "Okay."

The next moment, Xiao Jing waved his hand.

A powerful force suddenly emerged from everyone.

Buzz —

Space vibration.

With a click, the space broke open, and everyone realized that the wasteland I just saw was just a projection.

The space in front of you is the real ancient battlefield.

A strong smell of blood came from it.

"Go ahead quickly."

In the dark, a voice came.

Lu Xue's expression was slightly shining, and then she stopped hesitating and rushed in with Xiao Luo and others.

Another buzzing sound rang out.

The scene returned to calm.

Standing there, looking at the direction where Lu Xue and others disappeared, Xiao Jing remained silent.

At this time, a figure appeared beside Xiao Jing.

"Mr. He."

Facing the figure suddenly appeared beside him, Xiao Jing looked respectful.

"Four people, and one dragon is still in the way, only one of them is from my Xiao clan."

The figure spoke slowly.

Hearing this, Xiao Jing looked a little embarrassed.

"Mr. He, they are all very close friends with the Xiao clan."

Xiao Jing quickly explained.

It can be seen from the naked eye that Xiao Jing looked a little panicked.

But Lord He was not moved at all about Xiao Jing's words, but continued to ask, "Who is also close to me, Xiao clan?"

Upon hearing this, Xiao Jing nodded heavily.

"have."

Hearing this answer, he stopped talking and disappeared from the spot.

At this point, Xiao Jing breathed a sigh of relief.

He doesn't know much about this existence.

I only know that the other party has been guarding the entrance of the ancient battlefield all his life, and his strength is even more unfathomable.

At the same time, in the ancient battlefield.

"Fuck, this guy ran away!"

Qin Feng pointed at the distance with his sword and cursed.

Just now, as soon as they stepped onto the ancient battlefield, Chu Lingsheng fled quickly and completely disappeared from everyone's sight.

Not even a word left.

Lu Xue also frowned when she was still there, but when she thought of the oath, Lu Xue returned to peace.

Anyway, that guy just dares not regret the appointment.

Dare to regret it, try it.

"Sister Xue, where are we going now?"

Xiao Luo walked to Lu Xue and asked.

Before entering the ancient battlefield, Xiao Jing told him to follow Lu Xue closely.

This thigh must be held tightly.

Otherwise, I would probably not know how I died.

On the side, Qin Feng also came up.

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered and was about to speak, when Ao Qing suddenly came out.

"My little master, I smell good things!"

Ao Qing's expression lit up and she said excitedly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned and suddenly remembered that Ao Qing's perception ability was extremely terrifying.

Especially for those babies.

It's a dog's nose.

"Okay, Xiaoqing, you come and lead the way."

“Let’s keep up.”

“Stack!”

In this way, the ancient battlefield treasure hunting team was officially established.

Three people and one dragon began to rush towards the depths of the wasteland.

As we arrived along the way, countless wreckage and ruins came into our eyes, and the few people were in a state of great suffocation.

How tragic the war back then was.

The ancient battlefield did not disappoint Lu Xue and others.

Various resources and treasures emerge one after another.

Although it was accompanied by a huge crisis, under the influence of Lu Xue, everything was solved.

Soon, Lu Xue and others spent three years in the ancient battlefield.

On this day, a huge fluctuation suddenly surged out from the periphery of the ancient battlefield.

It is difficult to avoid being noticed when visions cover the sky.

"That's, Emperor's Tribulation!"

Qin Feng looked at the scene in the distance and immediately said in surprise.

In the imperial disaster, some people are going to break through to the Immortal Emperor in the ancient battlefield!

Without hesitation, Qin Feng suddenly fled quickly. After a moment, two figures appeared from afar in Qin Feng's sight.

At this time, the two were also rushing towards Qin Feng.

"Brother Qin!"

"Xiao Luo, Sister Xue."

The two are Lu Xue and Xiao Luo.

Three years later, Xiao Luo's strength has improved greatly and has reached the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm.

It is only one step away from the Immortal Emperor Realm.

However, this step has stumped countless people.

It is not that easy to become an emperor.

As for Lu Xue, in three years, Lu Xue is still at the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm. She seems to have made no progress at all, but her aura is a little deeper.

The whole person has become mature rarely.
